name: Watchman
overview: The biblical role of the watchman is depicted as a vital responsibility involving vigilance and protection, especially on city walls, towers, and temple gates, as seen in the watchmen stationed in Jezreel and Jerusalem. These watchmen were charged with alerting others to approaching threats and maintaining security, exemplified by the setting of watches day and night and strict gatekeeping to prevent breaches. Their duty was so serious that failure to perform it faithfully could result in severe consequences, underscoring the spiritual and practical importance of their watchfulness.
